judgment: It is good in the south-west.
If he does not set out,
image: So the noble one pardons faults
lines: In the field he catches three foxes,
He carries a load on his back, yet rides in a carriage —
and so he brings raiders coming.
Then friends come, and there is trust.
Only the noble one can untie it: good.
And there is trust with the small person.
on top of a high wall —

notes.name_en: 解 (xiè) is loosening a knot, release after rain; 'Untying', not Wilhelm's 'Deliverance'.
notes.L4: 而 reads 爾 'your'; the toe still tied to what was loosed.
